The '''Nebulon-C escort frigate''' was a type of [[frigate]] used by the [[New Republic]] and later by the [[Resistance]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. It was a successor model to the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TheAnodyne-RiseoftheResistance.png|thumb|250px|left|Aft view of the engines on the ''Anodyne'']]
The Nebulon-C was a class of frigates built by [[Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TLJ ICS" /> In terms of armament, it possessed numerous heavy [[turbolaser]]s, [[point-defense laser cannon]]s, [[tractor beam projector]]s,<ref name="TLJ VD" /> and 2 [[proton torpedo launcher]]s<ref name="TLJ ICS" /> as well as more potent armaments.<ref name="TLJ VD" /> The command bridge could be ejected in a case of emergency.<ref name="TLJ ICS" /> Similar to its predecessor model's use by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]], the Nebulon-C could be refitted to serve as a [[Hospital ship|medical]] [[frigate]], with one such frigate being used by the [[Resistance]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==History==
The frigates were originally built for the [[New Republic]],<ref name="TLJ ICS" /> however, in light of the mass demilitarization undertaken by the Senate, many Republic [[Starship|vessels]], such as the [[Anodyne (Nebulon-C)|''Anodyne'']], were decommissioned as salvage as of [[34 ABY]].<ref name="TLJ VD" />

The ''Anodyne'' instead landed in the hands of the [[Resistance]] paramilitary group, where it was reconfigured to serve as a hospital ship. It was [[Battle of Oetchi|destroyed]] when it ran out of [[fuel]] and fell into range of the pursuing ''[[Supremacy]]''.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROS Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] to one [[Standard year|year]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''The Force Awakens'' to [[34 ABY]], the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must occur in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Nebulon-C escort frigates were part of a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to assist the Resistance during the [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] over the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nebulon-C frigate appears in the [[2017]] [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].
